title: Trail echoes double-dim: fade multiplies RGB channels AND alpha, contradicting documented 'body color at low alpha'
detail: TRAIL_FADES is documented as an 'alpha ladder' and echoes as 'the packet's own body color at low alpha', but the code scales RGB by fade as well as alpha — echoes render roughly fade-squared, far darker than designed.
recommended_fix: Scale only the alpha channel (keep body RGB intact: rl.Color{body.r, body.g, body.b, u8(f32(body.a)*fade)}), or update the comments/TRAIL_FADES docs to match the double-dim deliberately.

title: Stationary packets keep drawing stale trail echoes forever — 'trails only while moving' is only push-gated, never cleared
detail: A packet that arrives and waits (arrival/waiting are 'continuous', so no snap resets the row) keeps its 3 approach echoes drawn indefinitely — trails_active has no movement predicate, contradicting the PR's 'only while moving'.
recommended_fix: Decay trail_n toward 0 on frames where !moved (or clear the ring when motion stops), so stationary packets stop rendering stale echoes.

title: motion_strip.odin header comment's lerp endpoints are off by one vs the implementation
evidence:
+// cadence times are exported. A frame at wall time t (tick T = floor(t/50))
+// draws lerp(pos(T-1), pos(T), (t - T*50)/50) — the render-behind glide the
+// app shows.
--- vs the code, which steps the sim at window START then renders t in [(w-1)*tick_ms, w*tick_ms): ---
+		if !paused {
+			sim_tick += 1
...
+						alpha = f32(t - win_start) / f32(tick_ms)
detail: Window w steps sim_tick to w before rendering t∈[(w-1)·50, w·50), so the drawn pair is pos(w-1)→pos(w) = pos(T)→pos(T+1) with T=floor(t/50), not pos(T-1)→pos(T) as documented.
recommended_fix: Fix the comment to lerp(pos(T), pos(T+1), (t−T·50)/50), or relabel the tick convention — behavior matches the app, only the formula text is wrong.

title: Mangled indentation block in run_motion_strip export loop
detail: The if-call line sits six tabs deep while its body and closing braces sit at three/four — a hand-edited region that compiles (whitespace-insensitive) but was clearly never reformatted or re-read.
recommended_fix: Run odin fmt over harness/motion_strip.odin; verify brace alignment of the cadence-export block.

title: measure_packet_motion.py crashes with traceback on '--xmax' without a value
detail: A trailing '--xmax' (no value) raises IndexError; a non-numeric value raises ValueError — uncaught tracebacks in a tool whose docstring advertises hardened argument handling (W3/W4/W7/W12).
recommended_fix: Validate the argv slot exists and wrap int() in try/except, exiting 2 with a usage message like the other error paths.
